source_cautions: Fort Charlotte accounts contain differing date/reign descriptions; article retains broad eighteenth-century dating rather than resolving the discrepancy without further records.
Montego Bay Cultural Centre homepage search text incorrectly states 1938 for full emancipation; that sentence was not used.
Seaford Town summaries give different counts of German arrivals with different apparent scopes; no aggregate figure is asserted.
JNHT photographs are attributed source illustrations. No open licence or verified capture date is asserted. NLJ Flickr image with explicit permission terms remains a source-page link.

Frome: parliamentary reply dated 4 May 1938 reports a 2 May clash, 4 dead, 9 wounded and 93 arrests; NLJ retrospective Flickr account gives 3 May, 4 dead, 13 wounded and over 100 arrests. Both are attributed; definitive reconciliation not claimed.
Kendal: Strictly Facts page wrongly calls 1,600 the death toll. Not repeated as fact. JIS memorial account gives 187 deaths; JNHT about 1,600 passengers and near 200 deaths.
Accompong: January observance is not substituted for the primary treaty document’s 1 March 1738–9 date. Family-origin claims in the short JNHT page are not independently established or repeated.
Roxborough: JNHT text describes original house destruction in 1968 and a restoration proposal; its later site photograph is not labelled the intact original house.
McKay: JNHT and NLJ early employment timelines differ. No precise reconciliation is asserted.

NYPL full McKay finding aid was retrieved as a valid PDF from its archive bucket. Its 1909 Songs of Jamaica date conflicts with the 1912 edition and other institutional records; only the supported family-background finding is used from that paragraph. The old NYPL URL returned a non-PDF response and was replaced.

Folly mansion: government chronology distinguished from the young-bride legend. Structural explanation remains attributed belief, not a reproduced engineering finding. Inline tower photo is the separate Folly Point lighthouse. NLJ house images and copyrighted Flickr postcard are linked for examination, not embedded as freely licensed media.

Mona: great house, estate aqueduct, Gibraltar Camp and relocated chapel are distinct. Chapel fabric originated in Gale’s Valley, Trelawny; 1940–1941 camp photograph date is a range. Photograph retains whole album page and CO 1069/371 item 76 identifier.

Moore Town: Smithsonian identifies musicians, track and album release in 1992; exact session date not established. Kromanti tradition title is not treated as proof of the language of every lyric. Community site supplies an attributed contemporary voice. UNESCO direct retrieval encountered a challenge wall; its challenge media are not used.
Stokes Hall: 1656 Stokes arrival is not substituted for a settled construction date. JNHT association and broad NLJ century attribution are preserved rather than claiming a reconciled builder.
Morant Point: African Kru workers are acknowledged from JNHT’s account; individual names and employment conditions are not invented. Historic light characteristics are not current navigation advice.

Ward: JNHT theatre-site chronology starts in the 1770s; municipality gives an earlier date. Precise reconciliation not claimed. LTM first pantomime is 1941, not the municipal Ward page’s 1951 sentence. Production credits come from LTM first-decade records.

Ward: Steven Brandist Flickr photo is dated 18 January 2025, all rights reserved, linked for comparison without copying. Photographer’s quoted commentary is not treated as independent historical evidence.

Flat Bridge: construction date uncertain, after1724; Long description published1774 is not an opening date. Labour quota not converted into an invented head count. NWA modern superstructure category not substituted for original materials.
Burchell: congregation, original destroyed church, successor building and former manse are distinct. The inline JNHT image is sanctuary interior, not the manse or the 1831 original.

Good Hope: DAACS archaeological account develops household/industrial history separately from JNHT’s owner-centred summary. Speculative family scandal and monetary claims are not repeated. DAACS hospital image remains external with a fallback after local403.

Spanish Town: surviving King’s House facade is distinguished from complete residence. National Archives Flickr CO1069/369 image names Kingston and is not relabelled as Spanish Town; not used as a square illustration.
Fort Charlotte: broad eighteenth-century date retained; mid-century wording/GeorgeIII context not converted into an exactyear. Barrack capacity distinguished from actual garrison occupancy.
Pinterest discovery search returned no authenticated original image for this bounded Ward search; this does not establish that none exist.

Marshall’s Pen: JNHT’s 1755 Balcarres-as-governor statement conflicts with owner’s early19th-century house attribution. Exact acquisition/building chronology not reconciled or silently copied. Publisher-indexed abstract supplies only the limited finding on non-uniform house-yard organisation; full chapter retrieval failed.

Lacovia: Spencer’s death in1738 cannot precede his supposed descent from the later British prime minister Winston Churchill. Claim not repeated as genealogy. Tavern fight narrative is a tale, inscription/date attributed to JNHT, not independently read from tiny source image.
Blenheim: inline birthplace image is a replica/reconstruction, not intact1884 fabric. Remembrance reports distinguished from lifetime events.
Halse Hall: grant, single-storey house at1702, late1740s enlargement, laterportico and Alcoa wing are separate phases. Enslaved workers’ names and current corporate ownership not invented.

Savanna-la-Mar: unfinished fort, equipmentrange and NLJretrospectivestormdates remainattributed; no currentrestaurant/openaccess assumed. NLJFlickralbumusedasdocumentarysource, notproofthatitsphoto rightsareunrestricted.

Liberty Hall: museum’s1923purchasedate retained, notsubstitutedwithJIS’sbuiltwording. GarveyJuly1921formalNewYorkspeech reusedfromexistingguide, notrelabeledasKingstonhallconversation. MuseumvirtualexhibitionURLcouldnotbeauthenticated; notinsertedasverifiedworkingresource.
